title: National Museum of American Illustration

services.name: Virtual Exhibition
services.desc: From the earliest days of the Republic, sports have reflected the values, aspirations, and spirit of the American people. Whether played on neighborhood sandlots, country clubs, winding rivers, racetracks, or packed stadiums, athletic pursuits have long been woven into the fabric of American life. Illustrators captured these moments not simply as competitions, but as celebrations of determination, camaraderie, recreation, and the joy of being outdoors. This month's exhibition explores how America's greatest illustrators chronicled the nation's favorite pastimes.
